DualFlow: An Integrated Business Management System

One web platform that runs two small businesses, Ateng's Inasal and Mortel's Car Wash. Staff manage orders, car wash bookings, inventory, and payments in one place, and customers receive SMS updates. Includes PayMongo payments, Semaphore SMS, role-based access, automatic inventory deduction, and double-booking prevention.

About Me

I'm a BSIT student at STI College Las Piñas, graduating in 2027.

On our capstone project, DualFlow, I worked as a full-stack web developer, building across the React frontend, the Node.js and Express backend, and the MySQL database. It was built for two real local businesses, so I learned to design features around actual needs like payments, bookings, and inventory.

I'm interested in web development, UI design, and data analysis, and I'm open to any IT role where I can keep learning.
